components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits. The stored value must have 8 to 15 digits
            after the '+' (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Optional create-time directive. When true, the owner is permitted to
            share a household with an existing owner, so the create request is not
            rejected as a household duplicate even when another owner has the same
            last name and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
            whitespace).
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region), derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table ('Sydney' -> 'NSW', 'Melbourne' -> 'VIC', 'Brisbane' -> 'QLD'). Any city not
                in the table derives the locality 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at the
                time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household - those with
                the same last name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace. Owners who opt in with 'sharesHousehold' to join an existing
                household receive that household's identifier.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9012345678901234567890abcdef123456'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created, sharing the
                same first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email
                is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - SILVER
                - BRONZE
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration date at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier rule: an owner's `membershipTier` becomes `GOLD` when their household (owners sharing the same `householdId`) has 3 or more members after the create; otherwise the existing SILVER/BRONZE rules apply.

The tier is derived in `OwnerMapper` from data already carried on the `Owner`, and the mapper runs on both create and read (`GET /api/owners/{id}`). Since household size isn't derivable from existing fields, I persisted it at create time — mirroring how `namesakeCount` and `bulkSignupWarning` are already handled.

Changes:
- **`Owner.java`** — added a persisted `householdSize` field (`household_size` column) with getter/setter.
- **Schema files** (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres) — added the `household_size INTEGER` column to the `owners` table.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — in `addOwner`, after computing `householdId`, set `householdSize` to the count of existing owners in that household plus one (this create). Added a documented `countHouseholdMembers` helper following the existing `countNamesakes` pattern.
- **`OwnerMapper.java`** — `membershipTier` now returns `GOLD` when `householdSize >= 3`, otherwise falls through to the unchanged SILVER/BRONZE logic.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `GOLD` to the `membershipTier` enum and updated the description.

The acceptance test `coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold` (third member of a shared household expects GOLD) passes, and the full suite builds green.
